headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Shed $487 Million While Bitcoin Holds Near 84k and Greed Runs Ahead of a Flat Cycle
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487.07 million on the Oct. 7 print, ether funds lost $160.77 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin trades near 84k, down 0.22%. Fear and greed reads 57, labeled greed, and the cycle index sits flat at 55, so sentiment is running ahead of the cash leaving the listed funds. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short print, the dollar is firm at 102.43, and volatility is quiet, with the VIX at 15.21 and seven-day realized volatility at 18.01% against 48.89% over thirty days, so the outflow is meeting shorts rather than a leverage chase or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
